definitions: A large, mainly tropical grasshopper with strong powers of flight. It is usually solitary, but from time to time there is a population explosion and it migrates in vast swarms, destroying all vegetation in its path.
Any of various North American trees of the genus Robinia, especially the black locust.
The fruit or pod of a locust tree.
examples: A swarm of locusts descended on the crops.
The black locust is known for its durable wood.
Children often play with the pods of the locust.
